title: Issues with 3.3.2.1
body:
Hi, I’m experiencing an issue with AndroidAPS 3.3.2.1 on a Samsung Galaxy S25 Plus running Android 15.

Installed: app-aapsclient-release_3.3.2.1.apk (client flavor)

Phone: Samsung Galaxy S25 Plus

Android version: 15

Pump: Omnipod DASH

Problem:
When going through the setup wizard, the wizard stops after name/synchronization/profile and finishes without showing any pump selection (Omnipod DASH is missing).
As a result, I can’t configure my DASH pump and only see limited menu options (Sync, Profile, General).

What I tried:

Multiple installs (removed other AAPS flavors, cleared cache/data, reboot).

Importing settings and without importing settings.

Issue persists.

Expected:
Wizard should allow selection of Omnipod DASH during setup. And also connect my profile because I set up my profile but noting in the homescreen en it keeps saying no profile.

comments.body:
Hi! You need to build fullRelease variant in android studios of browser build. The name of that app is AAPS. See wiki.

AAPSClient is not able to control pumps. It is the follower app.
